Name: Female Alex Vanilla Style Sprites
Author: CarbonDogMK
Description:
I really liked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/387]Adarin's original female Alex mod[/url]﻿, but I felt that the anime style portraits really clashed with the vanilla Stardew aesthetic, so I decided to take matters into my own hands. This DL contains vanilla-styled portraits for her.

I recommend using this with invatorzen and KeionDryke's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]dialogue change mod[/url]﻿. Just replace the Alex portrait and overworld files with those from this DL. Reminder to turn off every other girl in the config if you're only after Alex.
